The Falcons, led by [[Todd Simon (basketball)|Todd Simon]] in his first year as head coach, played their home games at the [[Stroh Center]] in [[Bowling Green, Ohio]] as members of the [[Mid-American Conference]].{{cite web |url=https://bgsufalcons.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/coaches/todd-simon/2093|title=Todd Simon|website=Bowling Green Athletics|language=en|access-date=2023-08-08}}{{cite web |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/standings/_/season/2024/group/14|title=MAC Men's College Basketball Standings - 2023-24|website=ESPN|language=en|access-date=2023-05-19}}{{cite web |url=https://events.bgsu.edu/stroh_center|title=Stroh Center|website=Bowling Green State University|language=en|access-date=2023-08-27}} They finished the regular season 19–12, 10–8 in [[2023–24 Mid-American Conference men's basketball season|MAC play]] to finish in 5th place. They defeated [[2023–24 Central Michigan Chippewas men's basketball team|Central Michigan]] in the first round of the [[2024 MAC men's basketball tournament|MAC tournament]] before losing to [[2023–24 Kent State Golden Flashes men's basketball team|Kent State]] in the second round. The Falcons received an invitation to play in the [[2024 CollegeInsider.com Postseason Tournament|CIT]] where they were defeated by [[2023–24 Purdue Fort Wayne Mastodons men's basketball team|Purdue Fort Wayne]] in the opening round, bringing their final record to 20–14.{{cite web |url=https://www.cincinnati.com/story/sports/college/othercolleges/2024/03/09/mac-basketball-tournament-bracket-set-miami-redhawks-face-akron-first-round/72907899007/|title=MAC basketball tournament bracket set; Miami RedHawks face Akron in first round|website=Cincinnati Enquirer|language=en|access-date=2024-03-10}}{{cite web |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/game/_/gameId/401625501/bowling-green-c-michigan|title=Bowling Green 66, Central Michigan 59|website=ESPN|language=en|access-date=2024-03-15}}{{cite web |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/game/_/gameId/401625504/kent-state-bowling-green|title=Kent State 67, Bowling Green 60|website=ESPN|language=en|access-date=2024-03-15}} ==Previous season== {{main|2021–22 Bowling Green Falcons men's basketball team}} The [[2021–22 Bowling Green Falcons men's basketball team|Falcons]] finished the season 11–20, 5–13 in MAC play to finish in a three-way tie for ninth place. They failed to qualify for the [[2023 MAC men's basketball tournament|MAC tournament]].{{cite web |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/standings/_/season/2023/group/14 |title=MAC Basketball Standings - 2022-23 |website=ESPN|access-date=March 5, 2023}} On March 5, 2023, the school fired head coach [[Michael Huger]].{{cite web |url=https://www.wtol.com/article/sports/bgsu-mens-search-for-replacement-head-coach/512-7449ad02-a272-4645-b47f-6de1878f499e |title=BGSU men's basketball head coach fired, search for replacement announced |website=WTOL|access-date=March 5, 2023}} On March 15, the school hired [[Southern Utah Thunderbirds men's basketball|Southern Utah]] Todd Simon the team's new coach.{{Cite web |last=Jimenez
